headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 10, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY, with an average return of 17.93% compared to SPY's 11.41%. This results in an average alpha of 6.52%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 42.70%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 10.68%, still above SPY but less impactful. This relative strength is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience against broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
